goal:
Rebuild the Daily Mood Logger as a full-stack FastAPI app with frontend and backend.

Frontend (Jinja2 + JS):
- Homepage at "/" with a dropdown for moods (Happy, Sad, Angry, Neutral, Excited)
- Text box for a short note
- Button to log the mood
- A table below showing the 10 most recent logs (mood, note, timestamp)
- “Clear All Logs” button to delete everything
- Minimal CSS: centered layout, pastel background, rounded cards
- Use JavaScript fetch() to call the API routes dynamically

Backend (FastAPI):
- POST /log → save {mood, note, timestamp} to mood_log.json
- GET /recent → return 10 most recent logs
- DELETE /clear → clear all logs
- GET /moods → return available moods
Serve static files from /static/ and templates from /templates.
